title: Mellow Yellow Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Mellow Yellow is a 3.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 94 SAVANNAH STREET*Please be advised that neighboring properties may currently be undergoing construction or renovation during your stay. As a result, intermittent noise or construction-related activity may occur at certain times throughout the day. This work is managed by third parties outside of our control, and we appreciate your understanding while enjoying the property. For additional questions or concerns regarding nearby construction activity, please contact Homeowner’s Collection at 1-855-411-1557.Welcome to Mellow Yellow | Seaside, Florida on 30APicture yourself in a charming Seaside beach bungalow located in one of the most desirable areas on Scenic Highway 30A. Welcome to Mellow Yellow, a grand corner home tucked away on Savannah Street in Seaside, Florida, just steps from the Savannah Pavilion private residential beach access. With expansive wraparound porches and unmistakable Southern charm, this iconic Seaside vacation rental offers the perfect blend of character, comfort, and location.Prime Seaside Location Near the Savannah PavilionMellow Yellow enjoys an exceptional location within Seaside’s pedestrian-friendly community, placing you moments from the sugar-white sand and emerald waters of the Seaside private beach. From this home, you’re also a short walk or bike ride to Seaside’s town square, dining, shopping, and seasonal events—making it ideal for guests seeking an authentic Seaside, Florida experience.Iconic Wraparound Porches & Outdoor LivingYou’ll know you’ve arrived the moment you see the oversized screened porches wrapping the home on both the first and second floors. The first-floor screened porch features Adirondack chairs, rocking chairs, and a bench swing, comfortably seating 10 or more guests. This inviting space is perfect for morning coffee, afternoon reading, rainy-day relaxation, or evening gatherings after a day at the beach.Upstairs, the wraparound second-floor porch offers Adirondack seating, a bench swing, and a hammock, all with peaceful Seaside treetop views—an ideal spot to enjoy the coastal breeze morning or night.Open-Concept Living with Coastal ComfortInside, Mellow Yellow features a highly sought-after open floor plan that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas. The living room includes plush seating, a large mounted Smart TV, and a Sonos soundbar, making it perfect for game days or family movie nights.The adjacent dining area showcases a rustic wooden table that comfortably seats 10, located just off the kitchen and island bar. The renovated kitchen serves as the heart of the home, featuring a center island with seating for two, glass tile accents, and modern stainless-steel appliances—perfect for preparing meals during your Seaside stay. Multiple access points lead directly from the living and kitchen spaces to the surrounding porches, enhancing the indoor-outdoor flow.A full guest bathroom with a walk-in shower and a laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer are conveniently located on the first floor.Thoughtfully Designed Sleeping QuartersThe second level offers spacious accommodations ideal for families or groups traveling together. At the top of the stairs, you’ll find a full bathroom across from a custom built-in bunk room that sleeps four and provides direct access to the second-floor porch.The primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a king bed with a white pencil-post frame, a walk-in closet, French doors to the porch, and a recently renovated spa-like bathroom. The all-marble primary bath includes a double vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower with a rain shower head.Across the hall is a second king bedroom with its own ensuite bathroom, complete with a double vanity and a shower/tub combination—offering privacy and comfort for additional guests.The Perfect Seaside Getaway on 30AWith its iconic porches, generous layout, upscale amenities, and unbeatable proximity to the Savannah Pavilion beach access, Mellow Yellow is an exceptional choice for a relaxing Seaside vacation. Whether you’re hosting a large group or enjoying a peaceful coastal escape, this home delivers timeless charm and effortless 30A living.Need More Space?Traveling with a larger group? Ask about the attached guest quarters, Lemon Drop, a two-bedroom residence that sleeps four additional guests—perfect for extended family or friends traveling together.5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break & Summer, 3 night Fall, 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES1,938 square feet of spacious coastal livingPrivate Seaside residential beach access: East Ruskin Pavilion1-minute walk to the beach: Approximately 489 feet from beach accessOversized wraparound porches: First and second floorsOutdoor relaxation: HammockFreestanding ice makerPrivate parking: Designated parking for two vehiclesSeaside amenities access: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote includes: Two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes (pickup at the Seaside Transit Authority)Guest services: Personalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & golf cart policy: Parking passes are limited to 1 pass for one-bedroom cottages and 2 passes for two-bedroom and larger homes; golf carts are considered a vehicle and count toward parking limits; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside; exceptions for medical or special circumstances require an approved permitNo pets permittedSTR23-002226
